slides.head: You sat down to start. You looked up, and it was evening.
A day with too many starts is hard to hold on your own.
slides.note:
Too many starts.
Not too little effort.

slides.head: Make it one block.
slides.body: Not the whole week. Just the next thing.

rows.text: Open it, and it tells you what to do today.
Miss a day, and it moves the work, and tells you what moved.
So you never start from zero.
